2026-08-20.content: Starting from August 2026, to provide modern security patches and support for MySQL 8.4 and later, the App Engine flexible environment uses Cloud SQL Auth Proxy v2 as the built-in sidecar container for connections to Cloud SQL. To use the latest Cloud SQL Auth Proxy container immediately, restart your VMs or deploy a new version of your application.

summary.title: Update to Cloud SQL Auth Proxy in App Engine flexible
summary.summary: App Engine flexible environment is updating to Cloud SQL Auth Proxy v2 in August 2026 to support modern security patches for MySQL 8.4 and later. You can adopt this update sooner by restarting your VMs or deploying a new application version.

2026-08-14.content: To improve security, starting in August 2026, App Engine opts your application into TLS version 1.2 and later. You can opt out until the end of August 2026. Starting in September 2026, App Engine might permanently block insecure traffic with TLS version 1.1 and earlier. For more information, see [Secure minimum TLS](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/flexible/secure-minimum-tls).

summary.title: App Engine TLS Update
summary.summary: Starting August 2026, App Engine will default to TLS 1.2 and later for enhanced security. You can opt out until the end of August 2026, after which older TLS versions may be blocked. This change aims to protect your applications with more secure communication protocols.

summary.title: Node.js 26 runtime now in preview
summary.summary: The Node.js 26 runtime is now available in preview for App Engine flexible environment. This update brings the latest Node.js features and improvements to your applications. You can start using it today to leverage new capabilities.

2026-06-29.content:
Support for deploying your existing apps in the flexible environment to Cloud Run using
the `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` command is in [Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages). For more information, see [Deploy an App Engine app in the flexible environment to Cloud Run](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/migration-center/run/migrate-app-engine-flexible-to-run).

summary.title: Migrate App Engine flexible to Cloud Run
summary.summary: You can now migrate your existing App Engine flexible environment applications to Cloud Run using the `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` command. This feature is currently in Preview. Learn more about deploying your App Engine app to Cloud Run.

summary.title: Node.js 24 Runtime Now Available
summary.summary: The Node.js 24 runtime is now generally available for use.

2025-08-07.content: To increase security, starting in March 2025, support for Transport Layer Security (TLS) version 1.1 and earlier is deprecated. [Update your application settings](https://cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/flexible/secure-minimum-tls) in the App Engine flexible environment to use TLS version 1.2 and later, along with a corresponding secure set of cipher suites (Preview).

summary.title: TLS Deprecation Update
summary.summary: TLS 1.1 and earlier support deprecated in March 2025. Update your App Engine settings to use TLS 1.2 or later.

2025-07-30.content: Support for [Node.js 24 runtime](https://cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/flexible/nodejs/runtime) is in [Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages). Node.js 24 is in the Current release state and enters long-term support (LTS) in October 2025. For more information, see [Node.js v24.0.0 (Current)](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.0.0) in the Node.js website.

summary.title: Node.js 24 Runtime
summary.summary: New Node.js runtime now available in preview.
